serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: See? Much better, right? 
Bot: It is much cleaner, but do the fish not mind? It’s rather cramped in there compared to the ocean. 
You: It’s a fish farm after all, but it’s one of the better ones. Fish here have fresh water and aren’t overcrowded. There are places where it’s much worse, trust me. 
You: You won’t catch a monster here, but if you want to get something for a family dinner there’s no place better.
Bot: Sounds great! Let’s get started!
You: Ready your rod. Do you remember what I taught you? 
Bot: Of course! Who do you take me for? 
Bot: I have an idea! Why don't we spice things up a little and make it a competition?
I think I have a déjà vu…
You: Something like a duel?
Bot: You could call it that, yeah. 
You: Sure, why not.
I wonder if my experience from fish joint trips will help me here…
You: Ok, let’s do it.
Bot: Ready? {{wi}}Go!
